PricingPage.metadata-description: Compare Nakafa Free and Pro for learning materials, practice questions, Nina AI tutoring, and online Tryouts.
PricingPage.drink-note: The difference is that this one lasts a whole month.
PricingPage.drink-idr: {count, plural, one {iced milk coffee} other {iced milk coffees}}
PricingPage.per-day-note-idr: Roughly the price of one motorbike parking.
PricingPage.per-day-note-other: Roughly the monthly price divided by 30.
PricingPage.q6: Can I learn without an account?
PricingPage.a6: Yes, public lessons need no account, and signing in saves your progress and opens Nina and practice tests.
PricingPage.a9: Nina uses {cost} credits for each answer to your question.
PricingPage.a10: Free credits renew every day, and Pro credits renew at the start of every month.
PricingPage.q11: Do unused credits carry over to the next period?
PricingPage.a11: No, unused credits expire when a new period starts.
PricingPage.q12: What happens when I run out of credits?
PricingPage.a12: Nina returns at your next credit renewal or with Pro, and lessons and practice questions stay available.
PricingPage.q13: Do failed Nina answers still use credits?
PricingPage.a13: No, an answer Nina cannot finish uses no credits.
PricingPage.a14: Both, so pick monthly or yearly for the price of 10 months at checkout, after you sign in.
PricingPage.q15: How do I manage or cancel Pro?
PricingPage.a15: Sign in, choose the Pro button and manage or cancel Pro in the customer portal.
PricingPage.a16: Your account goes back to the Free plan and receives the daily Free credits.
PricingPage.q17: Will the basic lessons stay free?
PricingPage.q20: Can I use Nakafa on my phone?
PricingPage.a20: Yes. Nakafa works in a browser on phones, tablets, and computers without installing an app.

Faq.q4: What subjects and grades do you cover?
Faq.a4: We cover K-12 through university. Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, and more. From elementary basics to advanced university courses.
Faq.q7: How does Nakafa ensure content accuracy?
Faq.a7: All content is created by qualified contributors and reviewed by the community. Our source-available approach means anyone can inspect materials and propose improvements. Practice exercises include explanations so you learn from mistakes, not just scores.

Landing.nina-lead: Ask from the question or lesson you have open.
Landing.nina-chat-answer:
Your \(13\) comes from taking \(m = 3\). That gives \(5(2) + 9/3 = 13\), but \(m = 3\) does not fit the question.

Check it against what the question gives:

\[\triangle(2, 4) = 2(2) + 4/3 \neq 8\]

With \(m = 1\) it fits: \(2(2) + 4/1 = 8\). So \(m\) must be \(1\), and the answer is \(19\).

Landing.memory-said-2: Explain it with an example first, please.
Landing.memory-said-4: I still get trigonometric limits wrong.
Landing.privacy-lead: What Nina remembers and the titles of your chats are stored locked, with a key of your own.

Landing.letter-student: I was a student too. I know what it is like to choose between studying and eating.
Landing.letter-fair: I think that is not fair. Whether you understand something should not depend on what is in your wallet.
Landing.letter-free: So <mark>the basic access to Nakafa is free. Forever.</mark>
Landing.letter-open: Nakafa is still far from finished. If something is missing, tell me. I read it.
Landing.letter-slow: Take your time. What matters is that you understand.
Landing.medals-title: Your study mates come from here
Landing.school-title: Nakafa is for a whole school too
Landing.school-lead: Exams, proctoring and Nina for every class, free to start.
Landing.faq-subjects-question: Which subjects and grades are covered?
Landing.faq-subjects-answer: From primary school to university: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science and more.
Landing.faq-account-question: Can I learn without an account?
Landing.faq-account-answer: Yes, public lessons need no account, and signing in saves your progress and opens Nina and try-outs.
Landing.faq-phone-question: Does it work on a phone?
Landing.faq-phone-answer: Yes, Nakafa runs in the browser on a phone, a tablet or a computer, with nothing to install.
Landing.faq-credits-answer: Nina uses {cost} AI credits for each answer to your question.
Landing.faq-empty-question: What happens when my credits run out?
Landing.faq-empty-answer: Nina returns when your credits renew, and lessons, exercises and try-outs keep working.
Landing.faq-accuracy-question: How does Nakafa keep its content accurate?
Landing.faq-accuracy-answer: Qualified contributors write every lesson, and because the source is public, anyone can suggest a fix.
Landing.faq-nina-answer: Not always, so check what Nina says against the lesson or the question.
Landing.faq-memory-question: Where do I manage what Nina remembers?
Landing.faq-memory-answer: In Settings, Memory lets you read, change, pause or delete what Nina remembers.
Landing.faq-data-answer: Nakafa does not sell your personal data, and you can delete any chat or any memory Nina keeps.
